description:
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded address, developed by DarGlobal on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai. The development combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in one building. Units span 109 to 722 sqm across one- to three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with sea or Burj Khalifa views from every unit.
Located on Sheikh zayed road, right at the entrance of downtown, you are connected to it all without the congestion. Giving you direct access to Downtown, Dubai Mall, and the Dubai Fountains.

faqs.question: What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
faqs.answer: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.

faqs.question: What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
faqs.answer: The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.

faqs.question: When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
faqs.answer: The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.

faqs.question: Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
faqs.answer: The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.

faqs.question: Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
faqs.answer: Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.

faqs.answer: The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.

faqs.answer: Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.

faqs.question: Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
faqs.answer: The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.

faqs.answer: It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.

faqs.question: What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.answer: Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.

faqs.question: Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.answer: The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.

faqs.question: What unit types and sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.

faqs.question: What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
faqs.answer: Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.

faqs.question: What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
faqs.answer: The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.

faqs.question: When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
faqs.answer: Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.

faqs.question: Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.answer: Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.

faqs.question: What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
faqs.answer: Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.

faqs.question: Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
faqs.answer: Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.

faqs.question: How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
faqs.answer: Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.
A prestigious Address
The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.
Location
Albert Hall Mansions is ideally located in one of London's most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic building offers breathtaking views and an exclusive address, balancing the vibrant energy of city life with the tranquility of a refined residential area. Situated in South Kensington, residents have access to Hyde Park, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and the luxury shopping of Knightsbridge, along with an array of fine dining, shopping, and cultural attractions. Frequently Asked Questions
What types of properties are available at Amaya?
Amaya is a 1-million-square-meter master-planned community by Dar Global in central Jeddah. In addition to completed villas and custom land plots, Amaya offers townhouses, mid-to-high-rise residential and commercial plots, and branded or serviced residences, including Trump Plaza.
Is Jeddah good for property investment?
Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's largest and most active real estate markets, driven by its status as a commercial hub and gateway city on the Red Sea coast. Demand for residential property in Jeddah is supported by a growing population, ongoing infrastructure investment, and ambitious national development plans under Saudi Vision 2030. Villas and land plots, like those offered at Amaya , tend to appeal to buyers seeking long-term ownership and the option to customize their homes. For buyers considering the Gulf Cooperation Council region, Jeddah offers a relatively stable entry point into a maturing property market with room for continued growth.
How much does a villa or plot in Jeddah cost?
Pricing for villas and land plots at Amaya in Jeddah depends on unit size, plot dimensions, and current inventory availability. DarGlobal has not published a fixed price list for the community, as costs vary based on the specific villa type or plot chosen. Buyers interested in Amaya should reach out directly to DarGlobal or an authorized sales representative to get up-to-date pricing for available units. This approach ensures buyers receive accurate figures reflecting the latest release phase and any applicable offers.
Jeddah vs Riyadh — which is better to buy property?
Amaya sits in a prime central location along King Abdulaziz Road, directly opposite the Red Sea Mall and minutes from the Jeddah Corniche. This gives buyers a coastal lifestyle address with direct connectivity to key urban and historic hubs.
What is the process for buying property in Jeddah?
Amaya offers full freehold ownership options for foreign buyers. Additionally, qualifying real estate investments at Amaya may enable eligible international buyers to apply for the Saudi Premium Residency.
What amenities are near Amaya?
In addition to nearby schools, medical clinics, and mosques, Amaya features signature community amenities. These include a 700-meter central parkland, shaded green walking trails, integrated retail courtyards, and the 4,000-square-meter members-only Vitality Club.
Can I buy a plot at Amaya and build my own villa?
Yes, Amaya offers land plots specifically for buyers who want to design and construct a custom villa rather than purchase a completed home. This option gives buyers greater control over layout, size, and finishing compared to a standard ready-built villa, and it is one of the defining features that sets Amaya apart within DarGlobal's Jeddah offering.
How do I book a plot or villa at Amaya?
Pricing varies by unit type, plot size, and release phase. Prospective buyers should contact Dar Global directly or visit an authorized sales centre to receive up-to-date availability, official price sheets, and reservation guidelines.

faqs.question: What is Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad?
faqs.answer: Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad is a collection of luxury branded villas in northern Riyadh, developed by DarGlobal. Mouawad, the internationally renowned jewellery house, designed the interiors of each five-bedroom villa, bringing its signature approach to refined finishes, artisanal craftsmanship, and timeless elegance to a residential setting.

faqs.question: What did Mouawad design at Neptune?
faqs.answer: Mouawad provided the full interior design across each Neptune villa, applying the brand's heritage in precision and luxury material quality to every room from the entry foyer and living spaces through to the master suite, bathrooms, and kitchen. The collaboration translates Mouawad's jewellery-house sensibility into an architectural and residential context.

faqs.question: What villa sizes are available at Neptune?
faqs.answer: Neptune offers five-bedroom villas with built-up areas ranging from 300 to 420 sqm. Each villa includes a master bedroom with walk-in closet and en-suite, secondary bedrooms, a family kitchen, guest living area, and terrace with views of the surrounding landscape.

faqs.question: When will Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad be completed?
faqs.answer: The project is under development with completion scheduled for December 2027. DarGlobal is the master developer. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms, or explore available villas via the online residence navigator.

faqs.question: Where is Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad located?
faqs.answer: Neptune is in the northern district of Riyadh, positioned in close proximity to the Expo 2030 Riyadh site, placing residents at the centre of one of Saudi Arabia's most significant urban development corridors under Vision 2030.

faqs.question: What community amenities surround Neptune?
faqs.answer: The Neptune community is supported by schools, a community centre, sports hub, restaurants and cafes, public parks, entertainment centres, early childhood centres, retail and grocery, playgrounds, mosques, and healthcare clinics within the wider neighbourhood.

faqs.question: Is Riyadh real estate open to foreign investors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Full freehold ownership is now available to foreign investors in Saudi Arabia. Property investment of 4 million SAR or more qualifies buyers for residency eligibility. The Saudi Riyal is pegged to the US Dollar, providing currency stability, and Saudi Arabia applies 0% capital gains tax, 0% wealth tax, and 0% inheritance tax.

faqs.question: Why invest in Riyadh property under Saudi Vision 2030?
faqs.answer: Riyadh is set to host the FIFA World Cup 2034, Expo 2030, Formula 1, and the Asian Games, driving unprecedented infrastructure investment. King Salman International Airport is scaling to 185 million passengers, and Riyadh Air is expanding global connectivity. Saudi Arabia is considered one of the safest countries globally and the safest in the G20.

faqs.question: What makes Neptune a limited-edition collection?
faqs.answer: Neptune is positioned as a limited edition collection, meaning a restricted number of villas are available, each featuring bespoke Mouawad interiors and individual design attention that cannot be replicated at scale. The scarcity of a Mouawad-branded residential product in Riyadh places it in a distinct tier above standard luxury villa developments in the city.

faqs.question: How do I register interest or buy a villa at Neptune?
faqs.answer: Buyers can register interest, explore available villas via the online residence navigator, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

Located along Jeddah’s picturesque Red Sea coastline, Trump Tower Jeddah offers breathtaking sea views and proximity to the city’s top landmarks. With easy access to the marina, Formula 1 racetrack, and iconic fountain, it’s a location that seamlessly combines coastal beauty with urban convenience.

faqs.question: What is Trump Tower Jeddah?
faqs.answer: Trump Tower Jeddah is a 47-floor Trump-branded seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche, developed by DarGlobal. It offers one- to four-bedroom apartments and three- and four-bedroom penthouses with direct Red Sea views, alongside the Trump Private Club for residents and members.

faqs.question: What unit types and sizes are available at Trump Tower Jeddah?
faqs.answer: The tower offers one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom apartments as well as three- and four-bedroom penthouses, ranging from 70 to 365 sqm. All units are positioned on the Jeddah Corniche and face the Red Sea.

faqs.question: When will Trump Tower Jeddah be completed?
faqs.answer: Completion is scheduled for December 2029. The project is under development by DarGlobal. Buyers can contact the sales team directly for current availability, payment plan structure, and brochure download.

faqs.question: Where exactly is Trump Tower Jeddah located?
faqs.answer: The tower sits on the Jeddah Corniche along Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coastline. It offers easy access to the marina, the Formula 1 street circuit, and the King Fahd Fountain, placing residents at the intersection of coastal living and the city's key landmarks.

faqs.question: Is Trump Tower Jeddah developed by the Trump Organization?
faqs.answer: No. Trump Tower Jeddah is owned and developed by DarGlobal Holdings Real Estate, which uses the Trump name and mark under a licensing agreement. The Trump Organization is not the owner, developer, or seller of the property.

faqs.question: What is the Trump Private Club at Trump Tower Jeddah?
faqs.answer: The Trump Private Club is a resident-focused facility within the tower offering fine dining, a cigar lounge, meeting rooms, a gym, a yoga zone, swimming pool pool, kids pool, jacuzzi, and 24/7 concierge services.

faqs.question: What amenities does Trump Tower Jeddah offer?
faqs.answer: Amenities include the Trump Private Club, 24/7 concierge, fine dining, and cigar lounge, meeting rooms, gym, yoga zone, pool, kids' pool, jacuzzi, and uninterrupted Red Sea views from one of the tallest towers in Jeddah Corniche.

faqs.question: Why invest in Jeddah real estate under Saudi Vision 2030?
faqs.answer: Saudi Arabia offers 0% income tax and capital gains tax, a 30-year corporate tax exemption, and premium Saudi residency eligibility for investments of 4 million SAR or more. The SAR is pegged to the US dollar, and Saudi Arabia hosts Expo 2030 and the 2034 FIFA World Cup.

faqs.question: What makes Trump Tower Jeddah's location on the Corniche valuable?
faqs.answer: The Jeddah Corniche is the city's most sought-after coastal address. The tower's seafront position, proximity to the marina and F1 circuit, and its Standing as one of the tallest buildings on the strip place it at the centre of Jeddah's long-term urban and tourism growth corridor.

فيلا استثنائية للإيجار بتصميم عصري مكونة من ثلاثة أدوار، توازن بين الفخامة والراحة. يتميز العقار بتتشطيبات "مودرن" فاخرة تشمل إضاءات LED مخفية وأرضيات حجرية كبيرة تمنح شعوراً بالرقي، بالإضافة إلى واجهات زجاجية واسعة توفر إضاءة طبيعية ممتازة.
تفاصيل الأدوار
الدور الأرضي (الاستقبال والخدمات): صالة المعيشة: مساحة واسعة ومفتوحة مجهزة بأحدث أنظمة الإضاءة المخفية. المطبخ: مطبخ أمريكي مفتوح يتميز بخزائن أنيقة وتشطيبات عصرية. المرافق: دورة مياه للضيوف، غرفة عاملة منزلية بدورة مياه خاصة، وغرفة غسيل مستقلة.
الدور الأول: غرف النوم: غرفتين نوم "ماستر" واسعة، لكل منهما دورة مياه خاصة وأبواب خشبية فاخرة باللون الجوزي الداكن.
الدور العلوي (ملحق فاخر): عبارة عن مساحة كاملة بتصميم مفتوح، تشمل: غرفة النوم الرئيسية سطح واسع مهيأ للجلسات الخارجية أجواء مثالية للاسترخاء والترفيه
الملحق يمثل تجربة معيشية مستقلة تجمع بين الخصوصية والانفتاح، ويمنح إحساس “بجناح خاص” داخل الفيلا لمزيد من التفاصيل يرجي التواصل على 0501699779
